target: Loss-safe normalized supplier catalog and public vacation/event parity
natural_destination: Public VII place pages and search

requirements.statement: All public consumers use accepted normalized data
Partial candidates cannot erase populated nested content
Dated and undated searches preserve their distinct contracts
The final 20-place sample has zero observed mismatches
Publication is exact, single and rollback-safe

risks.risk: Partial API data silently replaces complete accepted content
A release claim refers to an undeployed or duplicate build

cases.preconditions: Complete accepted vacation or event entry
cases.action: Remove each populated gallery, room, feature group and child image collection in turn
cases.oracle: Candidate is rejected and the previous generation remains active

cases.action: Submit an identical candidate twice and an additive candidate
cases.oracle: Identical normalization is stable and additive content passes

cases.preconditions: Known dated and undated search fixtures
cases.oracle: Dated availability/price tiers are ordered and undated results are not restricted to priced online inventory

cases.preconditions: Final candidate available on desktop and mobile
cases.action: Audit 10 vacation and 10 event pages including full galleries, units and grouped facilities
cases.oracle: Zero observed mismatches, no broken media and no horizontal overflow

cases.preconditions: All local gates pass and no operation is running, pending or uncertain
cases.action: Publish once and verify the original operation
cases.oracle: Exactly one successful Version and Deployment match the candidate and rollback remains recorded
